request.summary: Create a continuously filled rotating market ticker for a 6000 by 136 video-wall strip.
request.audience: Financial-information viewers reading live market movement across an ultra-wide display.
request.primaryGoal: Rotate four markets in order without an empty strip before, during, or after each transition.

assumptions: The five supplied datasources retain independent Wallboard bindings and refresh lifecycles.
Rows without a valid live price are excluded and missing stock logos use a ticker-symbol fallback.
Version 1 is preserved for replacement uploads to the existing app record.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The production requirement is a specific 6000 by 136 LED wall strip, so quality on that canvas outranks unrelated fallback compositions.

settings.purpose: Duration of the moving exchange title phase.
Exchange title typography independent of ticker symbols.
Message when no market has valid rows.

states.expectation: NASDAQ entries fill the complete 6000-pixel strip while moving.
The next exchange title appears after the prior market exits.
A short FX dataset repeats safely without exposing an empty strip.
Ticker-symbol tiles replace unavailable stock logos.
Rows with invalid prices are filtered and a quiet empty state remains.
Missing datasource bindings render a stable configured empty state.

behaviors.expectation: The red exchange title visibly travels right to left during its phase.
The final canonical stock exits fully while cloned content still covers the viewport.
Markets transition in the configured canonical order.

visualDirection.summary: A purpose-built financial broadcast strip whose cadence, density, and motion are composed for one extreme LED canvas.
signatureChoices: Exchange titles temporarily take over the full moving track.
Canonical and cloned market entries maintain uninterrupted visual density.
avoid: Scaling a conventional dashboard down into the strip.

visualReview.intent: A dense broadcast-style financial strip that remains continuously populated and readable at extreme width.
focus: Inspect the full 6000 by 136 frame for empty gaps, partial vertical clipping, and uneven item cadence.
Verify the exchange title and every ticker glyph retain safe vertical ink clearance throughout motion.
